description: This Java class 'DataLoader' is a Spring configuration component responsible for seed data initialization. It defines a bean that, upon application startup, checks if the product database is empty and, if so, populates it with a pre-defined list of sample products.

classes.name: DataLoader
classes.description: Configuration class that seeds initial product data into the database if empty.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Defines a CommandLineRunner bean that populates the product repository with sample data during application startup if the database is empty.
